summary: Full backend + frontend regression of NexusTrade (Delta India trading dashboard). Seeded MongoDB-based sessions per /app/auth_testing.md, exercised all documented endpoints, and Playwright-validated every documented page/testid on desktop + mobile. 30/30 backend tests pass. 10/11 frontend flows pass; the only failure is a UX lag on the nav's engine-status badge (10s poll) — dashboard state itself updates immediately.

minor.issue: Only accepts logout via cookie (Cookie param), not via Authorization Bearer header. Non-blocking since frontend uses cookie, but inconsistent with the rest of the API which supports both.

ui_bugs.issue: Engine status badge in the nav polls every 10s and does not refresh when the user clicks Start/Stop from Dashboard. So the nav shows 'Engine Idle' for up to 10s after starting. Consider pushing engine state via context or invalidating on start/stop actions.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> instrumentation wrappers rendered inside <option> elements (probably from the visual-editor x-* instrumentation). Not user-visible but pollutes the console with 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' errors.

action_items: Optional: When user clicks engine start/stop from Dashboard, broadcast the new engine state (via context or event) so Layout's nav badge updates immediately instead of waiting for the 10s poll.
Optional: Suppress or remove the visual-editor x-* option wrappers on the Trade product select to silence the React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: delta_client.request has a redundant `time_in_force` default in models plus explicit set in trading.py; harmless but duplicative.
auth.logout only reads the cookie; consider also honoring Authorization Bearer for API-token clients.
SettingsIn allows partial updates but PUT /api/settings won't unset fields (only $set). Acceptable given defaults.
delta_client is created once with global httpx.AsyncClient inside each call — fine for low traffic but could be pooled.
trading.place_order stores the entire Delta 'raw' response in Mongo; may bloat if the raw payload is large. Consider stripping.
test_credentials: Seeded via MongoDB per /app/auth_testing.md. FE session used during playwright: session_token=test_session_fe_1786797222223, user_id=test-user-fe-1786797222223 (test_database). BE regression session bootstrapped per-run inside the pytest fixture and cleaned up after.
seed_data_creation: Two throwaway test users + user_sessions in test_database.users / test_database.user_sessions (TEST_ prefixed for the pytest run; auto-cleaned by fixture teardown). Broker connection was written/removed as part of the flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/backend_test.py -v`. Auth seed pattern is documented in /app/auth_testing.md (Mongo user + user_sessions insert, then Bearer or cookie). Delta /test endpoint returns 4xx (as expected with restricted keys) but the signing pipeline is verified not to crash. Broker save/read/delete + strategies auto-seed + engine start/stop + logs population are all working. The only minor UX bug is the nav engine-status polling lag.
rca of the issue: Nav engine-status lag RCA: Layout.jsx has its own useEffect polling engineApi.get() every 10s in isolation from Dashboard's local engine state. When Dashboard toggles the engine, only its local state is refreshed via `load()`. Fix: lift engine state into AuthContext or a dedicated context, or emit a custom event from Dashboard that Layout listens to. Reproduction: Log in with a seeded cookie, open /dashboard, click engine-start-btn. Dashboard immediately shows Stop Engine button, but the top-right 'Engine Idle' badge remains Idle for up to 10s.
